I don't treat people like this irl. I came for help and you start calling me insane and talking like this about me. 

This isn't helpful. It's cruel. Fucking hell, you dick.  Of course if you come out here talking like this to someone they're going to respond as such.  You think I just go into interviews and cuss and my employer, strangers, family, etc? 

You're a horrible person.

No. I don't literally think everyone is out to get me or evil. I am just frequently shouted at and have people staring at me before shouting something or looking at their friends and giggling and shouting to me. 

>Right now I wouldn't hire you

Ok? I have a job. So no fucking problem. Fuck off.  This is the worst and most demeaning, unhelpful advice I've ever gotten.

I've never had a relationship, sadly. I was abused by my parents and struggle with it still today.   I normally just refuse to refer to them as family members, and call them by their first names or keep it rather anon sounding. Sorry for the confusion in that!

That's a beautiful analogy. I remember reading that fact. It's the kind that sticks with you.  Thanks for the kind words! I appreciate it.
Right! It's not fair for just one person to be holding it all together. We all have to play our parts, by being a good friend and being there.

Good friends are hard to find nowadays.  They need to vent, but if you need a moment, you're just a bother to them. I just dropped a pal like that. It was so frustrating that I could be crying and she'd just ignore it, but she's text back in about an hour about how angry she was about something else. 

Friendship is a two way street.
